coverage.description: Position checks each anchor is 1..sentence_count, rejects no anchors, uses maximum anchor, rejects backward maximum relative to current sentence, derives paragraph from text, and validates optional Cursor sentence/paragraph/chapter. need checks registry kind before existence; need_event checks event presence. need_cause excludes absent cause with Silent but does not itself reject negation; real_cause rejects negated events. need_any chooses event versus entity lookup; not_part excludes an object with known PartOf.
